facts.business: Voltaire Leasing & Finance Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) engaged in financial activities including providing loans and advances, and advances for acquisition of shares and securities.

auditor.name: SMPL & Associates, Chartered Accountants, Mumbai (FRN - 136549W)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: 1. Certain balances of trade receivables, trade payables, and loans and advances are subject to confirmation, reconciliation, and consequential adjustments. 2. The Company meets criteria for NBFC registration under Section 45-IA of RBI Act, 1934 but has not obtained registration. 3. Advances totaling INR 1251.62 Lakhs given for acquisition of shares/securities are pending settlement. 4. Interest income not recognized on some outstanding loans/advances as it could not be crystallized; management relies on recovery of principal and ECL provisioning.

key_risks: Non-compliance with NBFC registration requirement under RBI Act
Significant advances (INR 1251.62 Lakhs) pending settlement for share/securities acquisition
Interest income not recognized on certain loans/advances due to non-crystallization
Balances subject to confirmation and reconciliation
High estimation uncertainty in ECL provisioning for financial assets
